summary: Full e2e test of The Cafeteria (backend + frontend). Backend: 26 pytest cases against public URL — all pass (menu 22 seeded items, category/search/include_unavailable filters, 8 categories, settings, reviews, order create with CAF#### + pending status, mobile lookup, admin menu CRUD, image upload data-URL, admin order list + status update, settings PUT, review delete, and 401/403 enforcement on all 8 admin endpoints). Frontend: homepage (hero, 4 CTAs, delivery banner, Today's Special, Best Sellers, Party, Reviews, Contact+QR), menu page (22 cards render, search + category pills filter, add-to-cart & qty stepper), cart sheet (inc/dec/remove, subtotal, checkout nav), checkout (validation, COD place order -> /orders with CAF1001, WhatsApp order -> order persisted + wa.me tab opened), My Orders (find by mobile, invalid-mobile validation, Reorder repopulates cart), Admin (Google login gate, cookie-injected session -> dashboard, add/edit/delete item, order status persisted, reviews list, settings save persisted, logout). Mobile (390px) and tablet (768px) checked - no horizontal overflow, hamburger nav works. Found and fixed 1 CRITICAL frontend crash bug (useEffect returning a Promise).

minor.issue: order_number is generated from db.orders.count_documents({}) + 1001, so numbers repeat after any order deletion and can collide under concurrent creates (reproduced: CAF1001 was reissued after test orders were purged). Use a counters collection / findOneAndUpdate $inc for a monotonic sequence.

Uses `request: Request = None` and calls require_admin manually instead of a dependency; auth works but a missing Request would raise AttributeError. Prefer splitting into /api/orders/admin with Depends(require_admin).
@app.on_event("startup") is deprecated in current FastAPI; migrate to lifespan handler.
Accepts raw dict and any arbitrary status string (no Pydantic model / enum validation against STATUSES).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: `useEffect(load, [])` where `load` returns a Promise made React treat the promise as a cleanup fn -> 'TypeError: destroy is not a function' uncaught runtime error overlay; admin dashboard crashed when switching tabs (Reviews rendered 0 items, Settings tab became unreachable). Changed to `useEffect(() => { load(); }, [])` in 3 places; re-tested all 4 tabs with repeated switching - zero console errors.
Items saved without an image show the browser broken-image icon + alt text instead of a placeholder (reproduced by adding an item with empty image_url).
Toast is centered over the navbar and covers the 'QR / Contact' nav link while visible.
Unknown routes (e.g. /some-unknown-route) silently render the Home page; no 404 page.

integration_issues.issue: GET /api/auth/me fires unauthenticated on public pages and logs a 401 to the console on every page. Functionally harmless but noisy; skip the call or swallow the 401 in AuthProvider.

issues: Review delete button had no data-testid — added data-testid="delete-review-<id>" (tester fix)
ESLint react/no-unescaped-entities errors for raw double quotes in review comment JSX

action_items: Make order_number monotonic (counters collection with $inc) so numbers never repeat/collide
Validate order status with an Enum/Pydantic model in PUT /api/orders/{id}/status
Show a placeholder image for menu items without image_url (admin list + public cards)
Reposition toast so it does not overlay navbar links; add a 404 route; avoid the unauthenticated /api/auth/me 401 console noise
Refactor GET /api/orders admin branch to use Depends(require_admin) and migrate startup seed to FastAPI lifespan
critical_code_review_comments: Never pass a promise-returning function directly to useEffect — it silently becomes the cleanup fn and crashes on unmount (this was the admin dashboard crash).
order_number derived from a collection count is not a safe sequence generator (duplicates after deletes, race under concurrency).
Admin.js is 376 lines with 5 managers in one file; consider splitting per tab for maintainability.

rca_of_the_issue: Admin dashboard crash RCA: MenuManager/OrdersManager/ReviewsManager used `useEffect(load, [])` where `load = () => api.get(...).then(...)` returns a Promise. React 18 stores the return value as the cleanup function; on unmount (tab switch) it calls destroy() -> 'TypeError: destroy is not a function', which propagated as an uncaught render error and replaced the dashboard with the CRA error overlay. Fixed by wrapping: `useEffect(() => { load(); }, [])`. Verified by switching all 4 admin tabs 7 times with zero console errors and full CRUD/settings persistence.
